title: Wishlist
intro: Pieces you're thinking about. Take your time — a wishlist helps you buy what you really want.
leaveMessage: The saved link opens in your browser, outside ClosetWise. ClosetWise never connects to online shops.

offlineNote: Links are simply saved for you: ClosetWise never connects to shops or tracks prices.
